notes: This source/test traceability contract covers the bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 Unpublish Interaction Class service in Umbra's opt-in, non-installable development profile. The declaration transition makes the selected interaction class no longer publishable by the invoking federate. Its focused production-filesystem regression adds the successful-void service-report boundary: an invalid class appends nothing, while the accepted post-publication transition appends its type-27 InteractionClassHandle argument before any separately queued declaration advisories. Timestamped interaction behavior, advisory delivery matrices, MOM interaction delivery, save/restore, DDM, remote transport, catalog evidence, validation, and conformance remain outside this slice.
